Package neupaths.api

Class LoadControllerCell

java.lang.Object
neupaths.api.Cell
neupaths.api.LoadControllerCell
public class LoadControllerCell extends Cell
NeuPaths cell type for distributing workload among a pool of LoadBalancedCells. LoadBalancedCells in a pool are identified by a cell name prefix and cell domain.

A Load-Controller's receptors and subscriptions should match those used by the LoadBalancedActivator(s) of the LoadBalancedCells in the cell pool. If multiple LoadBalancedActivators are used by the cells in the pool, then the Load-Controller's receptors and subscriptions should be the closure of all the receptors/subscriptions used by the Load-Balanced cells. When multiple LoadBalancedActivators are used, the Load-Controller will wait for stimuli to arrive on all receptors before distributing work to a LoadBalancedCell.

    • LoadControllerCell

      public LoadControllerCell(String name, String[] synapseNames, ReceptorSpec[] receptors, LogicSubscriptionSpec[] subscriptions, String cellNamePrefix, String cellDomain, byte[] cryptoKey)
      Creates a new LoadControllerCell object.
      Parameters:
      name - The cell's name at runtime. This name should be unique across the entire cell system.
      synapseNames - The synapses this cell listens on and/or connects to.
      receptors - The receptors this cell receives stimuli on. These receptors should match the receptors used by the LoadBalancedActivators of the LoadBalancedCells in the cell pool.
      subscriptions - The subscriptions this cell advertises. These subscriptions should match the subscriptions used by the LoadBalancedActivators of the LoadBalancedCells in the cell pool.
      cellNamePrefix - The name prefix of the LoadBalancedCells in the cell pool.
      cellDomain - The domain of the LoadBalancedCells in the cell pool.
      cryptoKey - The stimulus encryption key. Specify null to disable encryption using a user-specified key. If disabled, the stimuli will still be encrypted as part of NeuPaths protocol encryption.
